narrative.overview: A cream sheet with sand and peach laid on it in flat tonal steps, read the way a calm person talks: plain, first-person, unhurried. Depth comes from stepping between four tones, not from shadows or lines. Density is low; sections are separated by space alone; decoration is absent.
keyCharacteristics: Four warm neutrals plus one peach accent; no cool colors, no gradients.
Two grotesks: Cabinet Grotesk for voice, Switzer for reading.
Two radius tiers: 8px for controls and media, 14px for containers.
Motion is short and always gated for reduced motion and hover capability.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy between surfaces is cream, then sand, then apricot. A container inside a sand band flips to cream instead of gaining a border or shadow.

rules.name: The Peach Is For Doing Rule
rules.body: Peach marks the thing to press; selected state uses apricot; data uses terracotta. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Cabinet Grotesk sets headings, ledes and the contact statement; Switzer sets small labels inside components even when they are h3s.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing carries box-shadow, blur, gradient or border for depth. Press feedback is a scale, not a lift.

dos: Do set all text in cocoa (#2e2218) or muted umber (#6a5443); never pure black or white.
Do step surfaces cream, sand, apricot; flip to cream for a card inside a sand band.
Do keep controls at 8px and containers at 14px.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px tall.
Do use weight 500 for emphasis and Cabinet Grotesk only for headings, ledes and statements.
Do gate every animation behind reduced motion and every hover behind hover capability.
Do write labels and tabs in sentence or lower case.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, grain or icon-card grids.
Don't use peach for data or terracotta for buttons.
Don't separate sections with rules or borders; use space.
Don't use bold above 500, and don't track out small text.
Don't let any element exceed the viewport: titles and values use overflow-wrap: anywhere.
